description: Implement the core infrastructure: build system (Makefile), common headers (value representation with NaN-boxing, object types), memory management (GC with mark-and-sweep, 16KB heap pages), and the basic object system (strings, lists, maps). This is the foundation everything else builds on.
steps: Create /projects/sandbox/vek/Makefile with targets: all (build), test (run tests), clean, and debug (build with -g -O0). Use clang with -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -O2 for release. Output binary to build/vek. Compile all src/*.c files.

Create /projects/sandbox/vek/src/common.h with standard includes (stdio, stdlib, string, stdint, stdbool, stddef, assert), utility macros (GROW_CAPACITY, GROW_ARRAY, FREE_ARRAY), and forward declarations of key types.

Create /projects/sandbox/vek/src/value.h implementing NaN-boxing per design doc section 12.2: top 16 bits encoding (0x7FF8=pointer, 0x7FF9=integer 48-bit signed, 0x7FFA=bool, 0x7FFB=nil/undefined). Include macros: IS_NIL, IS_BOOL, IS_INT, IS_FLOAT, IS_PTR, AS_BOOL, AS_INT, AS_DOUBLE, AS_PTR, BOOL_VAL, INT_VAL, FLOAT_VAL, NIL_VAL, PTR_VAL. Also IS_FALSY (only nil and false are falsy per section 4.14).

Create /projects/sandbox/vek/src/object.h and /projects/sandbox/vek/src/object.c with the object system: ObjHeader (type, flags with mark/pin/large bits, size, hash, page backpointer), ObjString (header + length + hash + data[]), ObjList (header + length + capacity + data pointer), ObjMap (header + length + capacity + entries with open-addressing linear probing, insertion-ordered), ObjBytes (header + length + data[]), ObjClosure (header + function + upvalues). String interning table for identifier-like strings.

Create /projects/sandbox/vek/src/memory.h and /projects/sandbox/vek/src/memory.c with memory allocation: vek_alloc, vek_realloc, vek_free wrappers that track bytes_allocated. Page-based heap with 16KB pages, bump allocation within pages, free-list mode when page fills.

Create /projects/sandbox/vek/src/gc.h and /projects/sandbox/vek/src/gc.c implementing mark-and-sweep: gc_collect triggers at 2x heap heuristic, mark phase (roots from VM globals/stack/upvalues), mark transitively following pointers, sweep phase freeing unmarked objects. Include vm_pin/vm_unpin for C code holding references.
Create /projects/sandbox/vek/src/main.c as a minimal entry point that prints version info and exits (will be extended later). Include a --version flag.
acceptance_criteria: Running 'make' produces build/vek binary without errors or warnings
NaN-boxing roundtrips correctly: encoding then decoding int, float, bool, nil, pointer all return original values
Object allocation works: can allocate ObjString, ObjList, ObjMap
GC mark-and-sweep correctly frees unreachable objects and preserves reachable ones
verification: Run 'make' and confirm it exits with code 0 and produces build/vek
Run './build/vek --version' and confirm output contains 'vek' and a version number
Run 'make test' and confirm all unit tests pass (tests for value encoding, object allocation, GC)
findings: IS_FLOAT macro required comparing against QNAN_BITS (0x7FF8...) not QNAN_MASK (0xFFF8...). GC tests need cleanup collections between tests to handle leftover objects from previous test's unpin operations. All 48 tests pass. Build is warning-free with -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic.
